concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-compliance-financial-products-customer-service-support]] — 2024-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Platforms financial-products support guideline for first/second-line ownership, accessible channels, 24/7 critical-query intake and UK/Ireland vulnerable-customer measures; not legal advice or service-performance proof.
warnings: The 24/7 requirement concerns ability to raise critical queries or notifications, not a guaranteed staffed or completed response.
Additional vulnerable-customer measures are expressly scoped to UK and Ireland; this is dated guidance, not current legal advice.
